method: Read-only source, Git object and existing Linux result inspection. Reviewer ran no filesystem tests, Rust, product runtime, or new primitive probe.
accepted_checks: Fresh output directory refuses existing output and exclusive mkdir prevents overwrite.
Linux/aarch64/root/OFD constants/ext4 required before primitive execution.
Real libc fcntl syscalls and independent subprocess classic owners; only EACCES/EAGAIN count as lock conflicts.
GETLK exact type/start/length/PID asserted in both directions.
Child event reads use selector and os.read against one monotonic deadline; owned silent child killed and actual wait recorded.
RESULT followed by nonzero exit is rejected; holder and POSIX close control require actual exit zero.
Failed owned child branches terminate and wait; parent FD and duplicated OFD FD close in finally.
Published boundary explicitly keeps product mixed-lock FAIL, bind OFF and G2.12/13 open.
Old154 and current157 map hashes and every input byte matched fixed Git commits, with zero mismatches.
All six historical/current reuse evidence references matched declared bytes and SHA256.
Config/startup diff confines new native behavior to ON; historical DFS local R1/OFF config lacks native TOML table.
Reuse classification expressly retains historical standard PASS and denies current6d standard full-suite rerun claim.
scope_limits: No AFS/FUSE bridge repair or product permission/session/epoch behavior changed.
No transparent classic POSIX qualification: OFD pid=-1 and close semantics differ.
No qualification of blocking, deadlocks, PID namespaces, same-client mixed ownership, access-mode upgrades or BSD flock.
No G1 reopening or G2 product PASS increment justified by primitive results.
Reuse covers DFS/local-file/gRPC/local R1/native OFF only, not ON, remote/RN, full POSIX, aggregate capacity, performance or3FS.
